inputs.base_revenue_note: FY2026 ACTUAL (fiscal year ended 2026-09-30), 10-K filed 2026-11-06: total revenues 2,534.873 (Scores 1,652.2, Software 882.7). Replaces the prior version's 2,530 guidance estimate. Year 1 = FY2027.
inputs.share_count_basis: Fully diluted at the latest date available: 21.381M common shares outstanding on 2026-10-23 (FY2026 10-K cover) plus 0.113M dilutive potential shares (Q4 FY2026 diluted weighted average 21.559M less basic 21.446M, treasury-stock method). The prior version used the Jun-2026 quarter's diluted weighted average (22.703M), which averaged across the June ASR and so overstated the period-end count by ~1.2M shares. Held FLAT: SBC and equity-award taxes are fully expensed in the flows, so diluting the count as well would charge the same cost twice.
inputs.sbc_source: FY2026 10-K cash flow statement: share-based compensation add-back 185.457 PLUS taxes paid related to net share settlement of equity awards 112.564 (financing activities) = 298.0, 11.8% of revenue. FICO publishes no combined 'SBC related to equity awards' line in its non-GAAP reconciliation (only the 185.457 GAAP expense), so the two are summed. FY2025 was 156.7 + 204.6 = 361.3 (18.1%); the withholding-tax line fell because fewer dollars vest at a lower share price.
inputs.reported_fcf_note: Company definition from the Q4 FY2026 release: OCF 1,072.065 less capital expenditures 37.690, where capital expenditures = purchases of property and equipment 2.140 + capitalized internal-use software 35.550. The prior version's 996 (TTM) deducted property and equipment only and so omitted the capitalized software. FY2026 OCF is after ~224 of cash interest and before the 65 antitrust settlement accrued in Q4 but not yet paid.
inputs.buyback_note: FY2026 financing-activity repurchases 3,045.991 (2.5M shares, including the 1.5B June 2026 ASR), against 1,414.5 in FY2025. No cash was spent on repurchases in Q4 FY2026; Q4 free cash flow went to debt reduction (total debt 5,582.4 at 2026-06-30 -> 5,259.1 at 2026-09-30). 500 remains under the June 2026 authorisation -- an authorisation, not a spend. The flat share count is funded (FICO is a serial repurchaser), but FY2026's repurchases were ~3x owner FCF and were paid for with ~2.2B of new debt at an average price roughly double today's.
inputs.fy0_note: FY0 is the audited fiscal year ended 2026-09-30; revenue, FCF, SBC, debt and cash are all FY2026 10-K figures.
inputs.wacc_rationale: Built in USD, the flows' own currency. Cost of equity: 10y UST ~4.2% + beta ~1.25 x ERP 5.0% = ~10.4%. Pre-tax cost of debt ~5.8% (revolver 5.87%, term loan 5.76%, senior notes 4.0-6.4%), ~4.5% after tax. Weights at market: equity 21.49M shares at the current price ~14.6B, net debt 5.0B -> D/V ~26%. WACC = 0.74 x 10.4 + 0.26 x 4.5 = 8.9%, held at the prior version's 9.0% and identical across scenarios: the mortgage-pricing risk is charged once, through the scenario paths and the 25% bear weight, not again through the discount rate.
inputs.lease_treatment: Operating leases (ASC 842, total lease liabilities 30.9 at 2026-09-30) are expensed inside GAAP operating expenses, so the lease cost already sits inside the EBITDA margin path. Lease liabilities are therefore NOT added to net debt (one treatment, never two). Finance-lease payments are ~3 a year and immaterial.
inputs.notes: MODEL: owner-FCF component DCF (dcf-methods routing row 1: US operating company, software/data), unchanged from the 2026-09-28 version. No memory entry. UPDATE, not a rebuild -- see reconciliation. What moved: (1) anchors refreshed to the FY2026 10-K (2026-09-30 balance sheet, 2026-10-23 share count); (2) a prior-version anchor error corrected -- total debt at 2026-06-30 was 5,582.4 per the 10-Q debt note, the Metrics XBRL figure of 5,882.4 double-counted the 300 current maturity; (3) capex now includes capitalized internal-use software (35.6 in FY2026, 1.4% of revenue), which the prior 0.5% path omitted; (4) growth, and to a lesser extent margin and SBC, re-judged for FY2027-FY2031 because the event the prior BEAR case was built on has substantially occurred: FHFA announced in September 2026 that Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac accept VantageScore from ALL lenders, HUD permits it for FHA loans from 2027-01-01, Q4 FY2026 mortgage origination volume declined, and on 2026-11-04 management withdrew FY2027 guidance while 'transitioning to bespoke mortgage originations pricing' (the FICO Preferred Program). There is therefore NO FY2027 guidance to anchor year 1 on; year 1 is a judgment. Owner FCF = reported FCF - SBC - equity-award taxes - interest income; FICO is a net debtor so no interest income is stripped (interest is reported net, 'Interest expense, net' 223.3). The projections are UNLEVERED (EBIT taxed at the cash rate, no interest deduction) and discounted at WACC; last_fcf (736) is the LEVERED FY2026 owner FCF, so year-1 projected FCF exceeds it by roughly the after-tax interest (~177) plus the lower equity-comp charge -- expected, not a carry-forward error. FY2026 adj. (pre-SBC) EBITDA: operating income 1,265.7 + D&A 16.7 + SBC 185.5 = 1,467.9 (57.9%) as reported; 1,560.2 (61.5%) before the 65 settlement accrual and 27.3 restructuring charge. Marketable securities (51.7) are not added to cash: they fund deferred-compensation obligations carried in other liabilities. The quarterly labels in the Metrics pivot are shifted one quarter for this September fiscal year and there is no FY2026 annual row yet; every FY2026 figure here is read from the 10-K and the Q4 release, not the pivot.

historical_growth.growth_rate_source: revenue 5yr CAGR to FY2025 (FY2020 1,294.6 -> FY2025 1,990.9), i.e. the trailing rate BEFORE the FY2026 mortgage-score price doubling. The CAGRs to FY2026 (revenue 14.0% 5yr, 18.8% 3yr) embed a one-off pricing step that is now being partly given back and are not a usable run-rate. Equity CAGR is not computable: shareholders' equity has been negative since FY2021 (-110.9 -> -3,873.2 at 2026-09-30).
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity CAGR unusable (negative book value from FY2021). EPS 5yr CAGR 22% vs revenue 14% -- the gap is buybacks (29.3M -> 23.0M weighted diluted shares) plus operating leverage on score pricing. FY2026 revenue growth of 27% was a pricing event (mortgage score 4.95 -> 10.00); no forward path assumes it repeats and the base path assumes part of it is conceded.
historical_growth.notes: Owner-FCF series = company-defined FCF (OCF - property and equipment - capitalized internal-use software) - SBC - equity-award taxes; interest income immaterial throughout. FY2021 212.1 (416.2 - 112.5 - 91.6), FY2022 337.1, FY2023 264.2 (464.7 - 123.8 - 76.7), FY2024 318.8 (607.4 - 149.4 - 139.2), FY2025 378.1 (739.4 - 156.7 - 204.6), FY2026 736.3 (1,034.4 - 185.5 - 112.6). Equity-award taxes from SEC XBRL PaymentsRelatedToTaxWithholdingForShareBasedCompensation. Owner FCF grew FASTER than reported FCF over both windows (40.7% vs 30.6% 3yr; 28.3% vs 20.0% 5yr) only because FY2026 combined a pricing windfall with a halving of withholding taxes as the share price fell; through FY2025 the reverse held (owner 3yr 3.9% vs reported 13.7%), with equity comp absorbing most of the cash-flow growth. Neither window is a base rate.

base.growth_rationale: CHANGED for years 1-5 (was 12, 10, 9, 8, 7); years 6-10 UNCHANGED. FY2027 +3%: Scores about -1.5% -- one more quarter at the 10.00 mortgage price (Q1 FY2026 Scores were 304.5 against a ~440 quarterly run-rate afterwards, worth ~+115) is more than offset by bespoke-pricing concessions from January 2027 (~15% average on ~900 of mortgage-origination revenue for nine months), a first ~5% of mortgage pulls lost to VantageScore under lender choice, and a mid-single-digit volume decline; non-mortgage Scores +5%. Software +11% (ARR +14% at 2026-09-30, Platform +72%, non-platform -18%). FY2028 +4%: a further quarter of concessions annualises and share drifts; Software +11%. FY2029-31 at 6-6.5%: Scores on volume plus auto/card pricing without mortgage pricing power, Software high-single to low-double digits. No mortgage price step-up anywhere in the path.
base.margin_rationale: Year 1 UNCHANGED at 61.5%; plateau lowered 63 -> 62. FY2026 actual was 61.5% before the settlement accrual and restructuring charge (prior estimate 60.5%). Two new facts roughly offset in FY2027: mortgage concessions and share loss remove ~175 of near-100%-margin revenue, while the Q4 FY2026 elimination of ~15% of positions saves an estimated ~85 a year and the price carry-over adds ~115. Plateau cut because growth now comes from Software (segment operating margin 28%) rather than Scores (90%), so mix works against the consolidated margin.
base.sbc_rationale: Years 1-5 lowered ~0.2-0.7pp (was 10.5, 10.0, 9.7, 9.4, 9.2); years 6-10 UNCHANGED. FY2026 actual 11.8% (GAAP SBC 7.3% + withholding taxes 4.4%). FY2027: GAAP SBC ~6.5-7% (Q4 run-rate 43.5 a quarter on 15% fewer positions) and withholding taxes ~2-3% -- the FY2026 112.6 was paid on awards vesting near 1,600-1,800 a share and the December 2026 vest happens at well under half that. Held above the mechanical ~8.5% because grants sized in dollars need more shares at a lower price.
base.da_capex_rationale: CORRECTED. Capex 1.5% of revenue (was 0.5%): company-defined capital expenditures were 37.7 in FY2026 (property and equipment 2.1 + capitalized internal-use software 35.6) and 39.4 in FY2025. D&A 0.8% rising to 1.3% (was 0.6% flat): FY2026 D&A 16.7 (0.66%), climbing as software capitalised since FY2024 begins to amortise.
base.tax_rationale: UNCHANGED. FY2026 cash taxes 226.4 on 1,100.1 pre-tax (20.6%); adding back the ~47 shield on 223 of net interest gives ~21.6% of EBIT. 23% long-run = 21% federal + state/foreign net of credits, with the equity-award windfall (1.3pp in FY2026, down from larger) fading.
base.wc_rationale: UNCHANGED at -10% of the revenue increase. FY2026: receivables +62.3 against deferred revenue +32.6 on a +544 revenue increase; the reported +51.2 working-capital inflow is flattered by the unpaid 65 settlement and 13 of restructuring accruals, both moved to the equity bridge.

bull.growth_rationale: CHANGED for years 1-7 (was 18, 15, 13, 11, 10, 9, 8); years 8-10 UNCHANGED. The prior bull assumed a further mortgage price rise to ~12; with management moving to negotiated pricing that is no longer a credible path. New bull: FICO Preferred deals lock in the large originators for multiple years at modest discounts, VantageScore mortgage share stays in single digits because investors and the GSEs' pricing grids still key on FICO, the price carry-over adds ~4.5pp in FY2027, and rate cuts revive origination volume from ~40% below the 2019-21 norm through FY2028-30. Software grows mid-teens as Platform ARR (+72%) outruns the legacy run-off. Margin path UNCHANGED: the 15% headcount cut makes it easier to reach, the lower revenue path harder.

bear.growth_rationale: Year 1 CHANGED (+3% -> -6%); years 2-10 UNCHANGED. The prior bear waited until FY2028 for a regulatory trigger; lender choice is now in force for all GSE lenders and for FHA from January 2027, so the damage starts in FY2027: bespoke pricing becomes a price war (mortgage price effectively -30% from January), VantageScore takes ~15% of pulls in year one, volume falls further, and the carry-over quarter and Software only partly offset. FY2028 -10% as the price roughly halves from 10.00 and share loss reaches ~30%; FY2029 -2% as auto/card pricing freezes; then a commoditised toll growing 3%. Cumulative revenue to FY2029 is -17% (prior -9%), reflecting mortgage origination at ~36% of FY2026 revenue rather than the ~30% assumed before.
bear.margin_rationale: Trough raised 50% -> 52%, year 1 lowered 58% -> 57%. Roughly 600 of near-100%-margin mortgage revenue is lost against ~60 of incremental Software profit and ~85 of savings from the Q4 FY2026 headcount reduction: ~1,105 of adj. EBITDA on ~2,100 of revenue.

scenario_narratives.base: Lender choice is live and FICO responds commercially rather than defending the 10.00 list price: the FICO Preferred Program and similar bespoke deals trade roughly 15% of mortgage price for multi-year commitments, VantageScore takes a single-digit and then low-teens share of mortgage pulls, and origination volume stays below normal. Scores revenue is roughly flat for two years (one more quarter of price carry-over in FY2027 hides part of the concession), then grows on volume and non-mortgage pricing. Software compounds ~11% as Platform ARR (+72%, 156% net retention) overtakes the shrinking legacy book. Revenue +3% and +4%, then 6-6.5% fading to 4.5%. The 15% workforce reduction holds adj. EBITDA at 61.5-62% despite losing high-margin revenue; equity comp falls to under 10% of revenue as awards vest at a far lower share price. Free cash flow goes to the 5.0B of net debt (~3.2x FY2026 underlying adj. EBITDA) before repurchases resume.
scenario_narratives.bull: Bespoke pricing works as a moat rather than a concession: the large originators sign multi-year Preferred deals at modest discounts, secondary-market investors and GSE pricing grids continue to key on FICO so VantageScore adoption stalls in single digits, and FICO Score 10T and the Mortgage Direct License Program reduce the bureaus' leverage over distribution. The carry-over quarter and a rate-cut-driven origination recovery lift Scores high-single digits, Software grows mid-teens on Platform and the Accenture channel, and revenue compounds 9-10% for five years before fading to 5%. Margins reach 65.5% on a 15%-smaller cost base. No further mortgage list-price increase is assumed even here.
scenario_narratives.bear: Lender choice turns the mortgage score into a contested commodity. The bureaus, which own VantageScore and distribute both scores, price it at or near zero inside the tri-merge report; originators use the threat to force bespoke FICO pricing down ~30% in 2027 and ~50% by 2028, and VantageScore still reaches ~30% of pulls. Mortgage origination revenue (~36% of FY2026 revenue at near-100% margin) falls by about two-thirds, total revenue declines 6% then 10%, and adj. EBITDA settles at 52% even after the headcount cut. Auto and card pricing power is questioned next. The 5.3B of debt taken on to repurchase shares at roughly double today's price is the story: net debt/EBITDA rises above 4.5x, the 1.2B term loan due May 2028 must be refinanced into weaker results, and repurchases stop.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: UNCHANGED at 25/50/25, deliberately. Bear stays at 25% (house default 15%): the single-regulator dependency has now been exercised -- FHFA and HUD have opened mortgage scoring to VantageScore -- management has withdrawn guidance, and the balance sheet (net debt ~3.2x underlying EBITDA, 1.2B term loan due 2028) amplifies any revenue outcome into the equity. It is not raised further because the part of the old bear case that has actually happened is now inside the base path (FY2027 growth 12% -> 3%); the remaining bear is the deeper price-war outcome. Bull stays at 25% (default 35%): it needs negotiated pricing to hold share AND an origination recovery AND Platform sustaining rapid ARR growth. Base 50%. Evidence that would move the weights: the calendar-2027 Preferred deal terms and the first two quarters of FY2027 mortgage score volume and price.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Value FICO as an unlevered owner-FCF stream on a strict basis -- GAAP SBC and the cash taxes paid to settle equity awards are both charged, capitalized software is treated as capex, the share count is held flat, and no mortgage-score price increase is assumed in any scenario. The FY2026 pricing windfall is a level shift already in the base revenue, and the base case now gives part of it back through negotiated pricing under lender choice. Debt taken on to fund 3B of FY2026 repurchases is deducted at face, which is what makes the equity's bear case so much steeper than the revenue bear case. With management guidance withdrawn, year 1 is a judgment rather than an anchored number and the scenario spread is correspondingly wide. The house (SBC-expensed) and street (SBC as non-cash) values bracket the accounting regime the market is pricing.
key_risks_to_valuation: Mortgage-score pricing and share under lender choice (FHFA: VantageScore accepted from all GSE lenders, September 2026; FHA from 2027-01-01) -- the single largest swing factor, on ~36% of revenue at near-100% margin, with no FY2027 guidance to calibrate it
Terms of the bespoke / FICO Preferred pricing deals for calendar 2027 are undisclosed; the base case assumes ~15% average concession, the bear ~30-50%
Leverage: 5.0B net debt, ~3.2x FY2026 underlying adj. EBITDA and ~6.8x FY2026 owner FCF; 1.2B term loan matures May 2028 and 337.5 is due within twelve months
Spillover of pricing scrutiny into auto, card and personal-loan scores, where the base case still assumes modest annual price increases

Equity-comp charge: if the share price recovers, net-share-settlement taxes rise back toward FY2025's 10% of revenue and the owner-FCF margin falls; the SBC glide assumes vesting near the current price
Platform migration: non-platform ARR is declining 18% a year and its net retention is 82%, so any stumble in Platform growth shows up as flat software revenue
The antitrust settlement (65) is a term sheet awaiting court approval; DOJ/FTC and Congressional scrutiny are not resolved by it
Terminal value is roughly 60% of enterprise value in the base case at a 9% WACC; each 1pp of WACC moves value per share by roughly 20%
